title: Counit identity for the specified condensed base-change map
statement: Let Λ be any commutative condensed ring, ℓ a prime, k a field of prime characteristic distinct from ℓ, and X,Y,X′,Y′ schemes separated of finite type over k, with k-morphisms f:X→Y, g:Y′→Y, f′:X′→Y′, g′:X′→X and a commutative square sq: g′≫f=f′≫g. Write L_h and R_h for the specified bounded constructible pullback and pushforward, ε_h for their adjunction counit, θ_sq: L_g⋙L_f′≅L_f⋙L_g′ for the specified pullback comparison, and β_sq: R_f⋙L_g→L_g′⋙R_f′ for the specified unit-square-counit base-change map, as in def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category. For every K in C_Λ(X), L_f′(β_sq(K))≫ε_f′(L_g′K)=θ_sq(R_f K)≫L_g′(ε_f(K)). No properness or Cartesianity is assumed.

from.place: Normalize the base-change adjunct using its specified counit formula

lean.statement:
theorem boundedConstructibleBaseChange_adjunct (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (N : ProEtale.BoundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X)) :
    (boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ k f').map
        ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange Λ ℓ k sq).app N) ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ ℓ k f').counit.app
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ k g').obj N) =
    (boundedConstructiblePullbackSquareComparison Λ ℓ k sq).hom.app
        ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar Λ ℓ k f).obj N) ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ k g').map
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ ℓ k f).counit.app N)
